g.text: Layered configuration load (as built, config.py / cli.py)
No file, no environment, no user layer,
(relative or control char: ConfigError, value not echoed)
[absent and state env, dangling link or other OSError]
2. R3 directory checks over the symlink chain
(POSIX: owner is euid or root, no group/other write
unless sticky; links in sticky dirs owned by user)
regular file, owner trusted, no group/other write
options via strict JSON loader, kind json
(project replaces a key as a whole)
skipped when both layers are empty: Config()
(a failure here is a project value, unprefixed)
INFO "config: ..." line lists option names only, tilde form
include replaced, exclude appended to the effective
exclude and de-duplicated; the Config is never mutated
Include and exclude are not CLI-side replace() fields:
the engine merges them after normalisation.
A user-file failure is raised as
"user settings <path>: <reason>" (path in tilde form: the home\n directory is shown as a tilde, never the absolute path).
and exits 2. doctor prints one error line instead of source lines.
